Shoulder: with the shoulder axis only 100 mm above the plate (spec) and the base housing the yaw servo under a 78 mm bearing, the upper arm reaches the base/turntable at about +0.80 rad (46 deg down); the spec limit +1.30 rad is not mechanically reachable. Elbow: folding down past ~+2.36 rad with the shoulder at zero drives the wrist into the base (a pose-dependent self-collision for the host-side checker, not an adjacent-part clash).
